UBON Launches SP-50 Sound Pro Speaker with Wireless Mic

UBON has launched its new SP-50 Sound Pro speaker, priced at ₹4,999. The speaker features RGB lights and includes a free wireless microphone. The company claims the product will enhance party experiences.
